newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine to present new An-70 plane at Moscow show.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine to present new An-70 plane at Moscow show.

text.p: Ukraine's Antonov Design Bureau (ADB) will take part in next week's aviation show near Moscow, sending its newly-designed An-70 transport plane, an ADB spokesman said on Friday.
The spokesman said an An-70 made its first flight since completing its test period on Thursday, landing in the town of Zhukovsky near the Russian capital.

Ukraine has placed high hopes for earning hard currency from future exports of the An-70, designed for both civilian and military purposes and capable of carrying 35 tonnes of cargo for 3,500 km (2,000 miles) without refuelling.
The spokesman said the An-70 needed 500 to 800 meters of runway for take-off and landing.
Production of the An-70, which experts say will be cheaper than the U.S. Lockheed Hercules C-130 widely used in the west, will begin next year in Kiev and in the Russian city of Samara.
Two major buyers were to be the Russian and Ukrainian defence ministries whose orders total 600 aircraft.
ADB will also send to the August 19-24 airshow its new An-38 small passenger plane, which can carry 27 passengers or up to 2.5 tonnes of cargo for 900 km (550 miles).
Other ADB participants will be the mid-range transport An-74 plane, which can carry 10 tonnes over 4,000 kms (2,500 miles), amd the 10-passenger An-3.
